summary: BazaarLink's free tier is an OpenAI-compatible LLM gateway. On 2026-10-24 its free page listed 6 enabled free models: qwen/qwen3.7-flash, reflection/beam, stealth/glyph-cluster, reflection/beam-free, nvidia/nemotron-3.5-lightning-free and deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash-0731free; the roster rotates, so use the live table. Shared account allowance: 10 RPM + 60 weighted units/day without credit, 20 RPM + 120 weighted units/day with credit; counters reset at 00:00 UTC. No credit card required; 2 concurrent free requests per account. A site-wide 20 RPM free cap and additional IP guard also apply. After a free limit, paid fallback runs only when enabled for the key and the account has sufficient credit.
claim_steps: Sign up at bazaarlink.ai and create an API key — no credit card.
Set base_url to https://api.bazaarlink.ai/v1 in any OpenAI SDK.
Call a model ID from the live free-model table at bazaarlink.ai/free, e.g. qwen/qwen3.7-flash; shared limits reset daily at 00:00 UTC.
Respect the site-wide 20 RPM free cap as well as account limits; keep paid fallback disabled for the key if you want only free usage.

social_proof.title: Free LLM API + Free AI API Key | BazaarLink
social_proof.text: Try 6 enabled free models. Account limits are shared across free models, with an additional IP guard. Site-wide free RPM cap 20 RPM. Concurrent free requests per account 2.
